description: Space-filling random walkers trace flat maze-like ribbons across a full rectangular grid; default warm palette on near-black.
notable: Foundational nalee fill: horizontal/vertical-biased walkers respawn until every cell is occupied.

description: Same full-grid nalee fill as basic, but colored from a shuffled found-photo palette (bless/carmen) with one hue as ground.
notable: Palette lifted from photographed sources; background is popped off the same list.

description: Nalee walkers fill an angular arrow-like polygon clipped from the grid; the unfilled ground stays negative space.
notable: Domain clipped by a grid-space polygon before walkers ever spawn.

description: Walkers fill a pinwheel-like polygon clipped in world coordinates; the negative shape reads against near-black.
notable: Clip polygon specified in pixel/world space rather than grid indices.

description: An animated rectangular clip window sweeps across the grid each frame, re-filling the exposed region with fresh walkers.
notable: Rebuilds and refills the whole domain per frame at 12fps as the clip rectangle lerps around.

description: A blocky arrow-shaped domain morphs its vertices over the loop while walkers regrow to keep the shifting region filled.
notable: Uses naleeSystem.grow() to recompute walkers as the clip polygon lerps between shapes.

description: A rectangular domain expands in width and height across the loop; nalee walkers regrow to fill the enlarging region.
notable: grow() incrementally adds cells so existing walker paths persist as the box enlarges.

description: A filled rectangular domain shrinks vertically over the loop; walkers recompute to stay packed into the collapsing region.
notable: Inverse of grow-domain: height maps down from 80 to 40 as the loop plays.

description: Pipe-style walkers fill a polar disc with a wedge removed, tracing concentric tube-like rings on near-black.
notable: Polar domain-to-world mapping turns grid walks into radial tube rings via pipeStyle.

description: Two overlapping polar discs of pipe-walkers, the first clipped around the second so the tube fields interlock.
notable: First disc's domain is clipped by the second circle before filling so they nest cleanly.

description: Polar grid of walkers colored by angle and radius into a rotating oklch hue wheel, over drawn radial guide lines.
notable: Custom pathStyle sets hue from theta and lightness from radius; explicit polar grid drawn underneath.

description: Overlapping polar discs each filled with two-tone walkers, composited with a paper.js union outline; vibrant palette.
notable: Uses paper.js to unite circle outlines; discs painted back-to-front with per-disc clipping.

description: A polar wedge grows its angular span across the loop, walkers filling the expanding fan from a center point.
notable: grow() concatenates fresh theta slices so the disc unfurls like a fan sweeping open.

description: Overlapping polar discs as stacked objects, each a red or blue tube-field on cream, bound by a paper.js union outline.
notable: Two-color red/blue system on off-white; theta resolution scales with disc radius.

description: Circular discs punched from a grid field and refilled with polar tube-walkers; red/blue on cream, like plans of rotundas.
notable: Two-layer composition: cartesian ground field with polar discs cut into and stacked over it.

description: Inverse of the ruins layout: grid ground stroked in one hue while disc interiors take the contrast hue, figures swapped.
notable: Disc interiors filled with plain cartesian walkers rather than polar; figure/ground reversed vs polar-ruins.

description: Concentric centered discs of polar walkers counter-rotating over a long loop; red/blue tube-rings on cream.
notable: Nested centered discs rotate in alternating directions with random phase offsets over a 20s loop.

description: Five overlapping polar tube-discs stacked with front-to-back clipping, shuffled vibrant palette on near-black.
notable: Five pipeStyle discs, each clipped by the ones behind it; palette reshuffled per run.

description: Full-grid nalee fill at landscape 1600x1200, flat solid ribbons in the default warm palette on near-black.
notable: Same engine as basic but a wide 4:3 canvas instead of square.

description: A framed plaque with punched holes and a wipe-reveal animation; nalee fills the panel as a clip band sweeps across.
notable: Draws a signage/plaque frame with three punched circles; horizontal/vertical wipe reveals the filled panel.

description: A polar-filled disc rises like a sun through a cartesian grid field, the ground re-clipping around it each frame.
notable: Sun disc translated by sin(playhead); the ground field regrows to hug the moving circle.

description: Despite its name, a single walker space-fills a tiny 50x50 grid in one static frame; not an actual wave-function-collapse.
notable: Misnomer: no WFC here, just a minimal single-walker nalee tile rendered once.

description: 32x32 grid of hand-drawn roughjs rectangles two-toned by looping-noise parity; solid, hachure, or mixed fill modes.
notable: Roughjs sketchy cells; the tens digit of noise plus column parity picks between two contrasting colors.

description: The base noise-grid extended with gradient ramps, an accent color, and neighbor color-mixing across cells.
notable: Two-pass render: base colors first, then each cell averages toward its four neighbors before drawing.
